notes.title: 🚀 Stellarcraft Demo: MASSIVE Update is Here!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to present the latest update for the Stellarcraft Demo! This update brings tons of new features, improvements, and fresh content — all designed to take your tower defense experience to the next level.

[previewyoutube=mrF_thsEEv4;full][/previewyoutube]

    ✨ New Features & Content
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    ♾️ Roguelike Endless Mode
    
        A brand-new endless mode with randomly generated challenges for limitless gameplay. Collect up to 4 stars the further you progress through waves. After each round, choose from 3 cards that grant powerful buffs to you and your team, making you stronger for the next section.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    
    🌍 3 Redesigned Levels
    
        Three existing levels have been completely revamped, featuring improved level design, balanced difficulty, and more thrilling challenges.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    🗺️ Quest System
    
        A brand-new quest system adds extra objectives and missions, offering more variety and motivation.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    👾 Many New Enemies
    
        Numerous new enemy types with unique abilities and behaviors provide varied and challenging battles.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    🧰 New Crafting Items
    
        Expanded crafting options with new useful items like barriers and mobile mining modules for ores, enhancing your defense and resource gathering.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    ⚒️ New Tower Upgrades
    
        Additional upgrades for your towers that significantly boost their performance, range, and special abilities.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    🛡️ Base Upgrade
    
        Your base can now be upgraded to increase its resilience and unlock better defensive options.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    🚀 New Towers to Unlock
    
        Discover and unlock new tower types that bring fresh strategies with unique abilities to your defense.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    📈 Level System
    
        Progression and leveling system lets you improve your character and skills, increasing your effectiveness in the game.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    🏺 Relics for Buffs
    
        Collect powerful relics that grant your team permanent bonuses and special effects to support you in battle.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    🎓 New Tutorial
    
        A comprehensive, easy-to-understand tutorial guides new players step-by-step through the game mechanics for a smooth start.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    📖 Tactics Logbook
    
        A clear logbook helps you plan strategies, record important info, and optimize your playstyle.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    🔧 Weapon Modifications
    
        Customize your weapons with various upgrades and mods to tailor them to your playstyle and boost their effectiveness.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    🎨 Lots of Cosmetic Content
    
        Numerous new cosmetic options allow you to personalize your character. Switch skins and wear cool hats to show off your unique style.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    🎨 Improvements & Updates

    🖥️ Completely New, Modern UI
    
        The user interface has been fully redesigned, offering a modern, clear design that makes navigation easier.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    🖼️ Graphics Update
    
        Fresh, enhanced graphics and visual effects provide an even more appealing and immersive gaming experience.
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    🎯 Our Goal
    
        We want to create the best tower defense game ever — and with this update, we’re one big step closer!
    
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183759/c2bf7fa187783c88572b1eaba53dc5c3d0b321c3.png
    👉 If you enjoy the demo…

    
Feel free to check out the main game, which offers even more content, features, and exciting worlds!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189820/Stellarcraft/?curator_clanid=42227948

Download the update now, start the demo, and defend the galaxy together! 🌌

notes.title: Stellarcraft: Major Update & Multiplayer Launch!
notes.notes:
For the past few months, Stellarcraft has been in Early Access, and we’ve been working hard to improve the game. With a completely redesigned user interface and numerous new gameplay elements, we’re thrilled to announce our biggest update yet: Multiplayer is now available!

You can now explore the galaxy together with up to four friends. To celebrate this milestone, Stellarcraft is currently 50% off – the perfect time to jump in!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189820/Stellarcraft/?l=german

Don’t miss out – check it out now! 🚀✨

notes.title: Hotfix - Black Screen Issue Resolved
notes.notes:
Hey dear Tower Defense enthusiasts,


Earlier today, we received a report of an issue where players encountered a black screen at the start of the game. We are pleased to announce that this issue has now been resolved. A big thank you to everyone who continues to support us in improving the game.

Changelog:


 The issue of a black screen when starting a new game has been fixed


Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios Team

notes.title: Quality of life Update 2
notes.notes:
Hey dear Tower Defense enthusiasts,

In the latest update, we've refined the details and made the overall experience even more cohesive. Additionally, we've implemented a variety of new sound effects to complete the picture and enhance immersion.


What's next?

We are now focusing on the final update for the Prologue (Demo). In this update, we will completely rework the tutorial, as there have been many misunderstandings. Our goal is to explain everything thoroughly to ensure a clearer and smoother gameplay experience.

To make this last update for the Prologue special, we will create a cool new map for the revised tutorial. Since this will take some time, the update will likely be available in about a week. If you encounter any more bugs in the meantime, please report them to us, and we'll do our best to fix them as quickly as possible.

You can track our current progress for Early Access on the Trello board. We're already working hard on it and making great strides.

Now, onto today's changelogs


Changelog:


 New Sound Effects: We've enriched the gameplay experience with numerous new sound effects.
 Escape Menu: Music no longer restarts from the beginning when opening the escape menu but continues seamlessly.
 Save Icons: Fixed a bug related to the save icons.
 Weapon Accuracy: Weapon accuracy has been optimized, making it more precise when shooting.


Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios Team

notes.title: Quality of life Update
notes.notes:
Hey Tower Defense Enthusiasts,


This time, we have taken additional measures to make the game more accessible and understandable for everyone. Additionally, we have implemented several visual enhancements to make the world more vibrant and engaging.

Here's a sneak peek:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059978/37f5864ed727c5234f43b0b2a3232fe229195011.jpg

Changelog:


 Fish, frogs, and dragonflies have been added to make the environment more lively.
 A new roadmap has been implemented.
 Level selection legend added.
 The tutorial has been expanded and is now fully integrated into Level 1.
 Settings are now permanently saved and no longer reset automatically.
 The issue where the lighting was always set to dark on the first game launch has been fixed.
 A bug where the spaceship sometimes couldn’t exit the level correctly has been resolved.
 The golem now attacks properly again.
 Levels are now correctly unlocked and remain unlocked after exiting the game.
 Interaction with the crafting table has been improved.
 A save icon now appears in the top right corner when saving the game.
 The error in the credits has been fixed.
 The text was edited when leaving the game in the hub.


Robin Hoffmann - DreamStudios Team
